cryptoTrack.network.listHint: Where the module reads balances and history. Pick a network to change its addresses.
cryptoTrack.network.editHint: Leave a field empty to use the preset. Only https:// is accepted; http:// works for localhost only, for your own node.
cryptoTrack.network.levelRequired: The addresses are kept in the device file, which exists from protection level 3, the level the crypto module needs. Below it the presets are used and cannot be changed.
cryptoTrack.network.rpcHint: The node answers balance questions. Preset: {preset}. The address stays on this device and is sent only to this node and to the Blockscout of this network.
cryptoTrack.network.blockscoutNone: This network has no preset Blockscout instance. Set your own to read its history.
cryptoTrack.network.explorerHint: Only for links that open a transaction or an address in your browser. Preset: {preset}.
cryptoTrack.network.keyHint: Empty works as it always did, only slower: a key raises the request limit. It stays on this device, is never synced and is sent only to Blockscout in a request header.
cryptoTrack.network.keyStored: A key is stored on this device. Type a new one to replace it, or remove it with the button.
cryptoTrack.network.keyPlaceholder: No key, reads go without one
cryptoTrack.network.keyRemoveBody: Reads go without a key from now on. It cannot be undone: you would have to type the key again.
cryptoTrack.network.outcome.unreachable: No answer: check the address and that the service is up.
cryptoTrack.network.outcome.wrong_networ: The node answers for another network.
cryptoTrack.network.outcome.bad_answer: It answered with something this endpoint does not speak.
cryptoTrack.network.sourcesWho: The public addresses of your wallets and this device's IP are seen by the services below, and by nobody else:
cryptoTrack.network.sourcesRest: The explorer sees an address only when you open its link. Prices come from DeFiLlama, which gets token contracts and no wallet addresses. The module only reads: it holds no keys of your wallets and signs nothing.
cryptoTrack.network.err.whitespace: The address must not contain spaces or line breaks
cryptoTrack.network.err.invalid: This is not a valid address, for example https://node.example.org
cryptoTrack.network.err.schemeLocal: Only https:// is accepted; http:// works for localhost only
cryptoTrack.network.err.credentials: The address must not carry a user name or password
cryptoTrack.network.err.host: The explorer needs a real host name with a dot
cryptoTrack.network.err.key: A key is up to 256 visible characters without spaces
cryptoTrack.consent.title: One-time consent
cryptoTrack.consent.what: Ask the networks for the data of addresses
cryptoTrack.consent.effectOn: While the consent stands, the module reads the followed addresses in the background.
cryptoTrack.consent.effectOff: Without the consent the module makes not a single request to the outside. Withdrawing stops updates: what is loaded stays, nothing new arrives.
cryptoTrack.consent.sendsAddresses: The public addresses of your wallets go to the node of the network and to Blockscout.
cryptoTrack.consent.sendsTokens: Token contracts go to DeFiLlama, for the price.
cryptoTrack.consent.sendsNever: No password, no keys and no seed phrase: the module does not have them.
cryptoTrack.consent.keepsBody: Withdrawing only stops the requests to the network. To remove the module and its records, use the Wiping tab.
cryptoTrack.hiddenTokens.title: Hidden tokens · {count}
cryptoTrack.hiddenTokens.emptyBody: A token you hide in a wallet lands here, and you can bring it back.
cryptoTrack.hiddenTokens.quarantineBody: A new token waits in quarantine and does not count in your capital until you press Recognize on the wallet page. Here is only the common list of hidden ones.
cryptoTrack.hiddenTokens.noAddress: No address is connected yet: the quarantine arrives with the first one.
cryptoTrack.hiddenTokens.noteBody: Hiding is a mark in the vault. The operations of the token stay in the history; the module deletes and edits nothing.
cryptoTrack.wipeEntry.title: Wipe the crypto module
cryptoTrack.wipeEntry.removes: Connected addresses and their wallets, events, positions, snapshots, prices and quarantine are removed.
cryptoTrack.wipeEntry.stays: Fiat operations, the other wallets and the exchange import by key stay.
cryptoTrack.wipeEntry.level: After the wipe the protection level can be lowered: the ban is lifted.
cryptoTrack.wipeEntry.askBody: The window will show the numbers: how many wallets, events and tokens go and how much the capital drops. It will ask you to type the word and check that a fresh backup exists.
tour.cryptoNetwork.list.title: Networks
tour.cryptoNetwork.list.body: Every network with the node in use and the result of the last check. Press Check to see that the node answers.
tour.cryptoNetwork.form.title: Your own node
tour.cryptoNetwork.form.body: Put your own node, Blockscout or explorer here. Only https works, and http for localhost. An empty field is the preset.
tour.cryptoNetwork.key.title: Blockscout key
tour.cryptoNetwork.key.body: Optional. Without a key everything works, only slower. The key stays on this device and is never shown again.
tour.cryptoNetwork.sources.title: Who sees the addresses
tour.cryptoNetwork.sources.body: The list of services that get your public addresses and IP. Change a node and the list changes with it.
tour.cryptoNetwork.consent.title: Consent
tour.cryptoNetwork.consent.body: The module reads the networks only while the consent stands. Withdraw it and the requests stop at once, with your data kept.
tour.cryptoNetwork.hidden.title: Hidden tokens
tour.cryptoNetwork.hidden.body: A token you hid is listed here. Restore returns it to your assets.
tour.cryptoNetwork.wipe.title: Wiping
tour.cryptoNetwork.wipe.body: The entrance to removing the whole crypto module from the vault, with a backup first.
whatsNew.cryptoNetworkSettings.title: Crypto: networks and consent in Settings
whatsNew.cryptoNetworkSettings.nodes: Settings has a Crypto group: set your own RPC node, Blockscout or explorer for each network, check the connection and see who gets your addresses.
whatsNew.cryptoNetworkSettings.key: A Blockscout key is optional: with it reads go faster. It is kept only on this device and is never synced.
whatsNew.cryptoNetworkSettings.consent: The consent to read the networks can be withdrawn at any time, and the requests stop with it.
whatsNew.cryptoNetworkSettings.tokens: Tokens you hid are in one list, and you can bring any of them back.
